invariants.rationale: The method execute is expected to return a non-null HoodieWriteMetadata<List<WriteStatus>> object.
As the input parameter, inputRecords should not be null for correct method functioning.
A valid HoodieWriteMetadata object should have a non-null write status list.
getWriteStatuses returns a List since result is parameterized as HoodieWriteMetadata<List<WriteStatus>>.
If there were input records, it is likely that write statuses will not be empty; if there were no input records, write statuses may still be non-empty due to other processing.
